snippet.description:
Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) is an upcoming open-world action-adventure game developed and published by Rockstar Games, the creators of GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2. Set in the fictional state of Leonida, inspired by Florida, GTA 6 takes players back to the iconic streets of Vice City, featuring a massive open world filled with crime, action, exploration, and endless possibilities.

In GTA 6, players follow the story of Jason and Lucia, two criminals trying to survive in a dangerous world filled with gangs, robberies, police, and criminal organizations. After a robbery goes wrong, the pair becomes involved in a massive criminal conspiracy stretching across Leonida, forcing them to work together to survive.

Explore the streets of Vice City and the surrounding areas of Leonida, featuring busy highways, tropical beaches, small towns, swamps, and a variety of unique locations. From high-speed police chases and intense shootouts to discovering hidden secrets, driving exotic cars, and exploring the massive open world, GTA 6 brings a new generation of Grand Theft Auto to life.

Grand Theft Auto VI launches November 19, 2026, for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. GTA Vice City came out in 2002, and Rockstar still packed it with details most players never noticed. Aim at an NPC and they’ll actually talk back, step where someone fell and you’ll leave footprints behind, and when a body disappears, it leaves a chalk outline. And if you’re too good at escaping the cops, they’ll throw spike strips to pop your tires.
